name: dead_token_is_not_a_card_in_a_graveyard_while_a_trigger_names_it
notes: Bug hunt 2026-11-17 (hunt 3 F4, hunt 2 H2-1; BACKLOG B-112, closed). P0's 4/4 Angel token dies; P1's Massacre Wurm ('Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, that player loses 2 life') triggers and waits on the stack. CR 704.5d, 111.7-8, 117.5: the token ceased to exist at the state-based check before the trigger went on the stack; it is no card in a graveyard, so Scavenging Ooze ('Exile target card from a graveyard. If it was a creature card, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and you gain 1 life') cannot target it. The Wurm's trigger still reads the token's last known information (CR 608.2h): its controller, P0, loses 2 life. Failed before the fix: the token was kept in the graveyard as its own last-known information while the trigger named it, and the Ooze ate it for a counter and 1 life.
